item.research_question: How do complex stress fields affect the deformation behavior of bulk metallic glasses (BMGs) and high entropy alloys (HEAs)?
item.material_system: Bulk metallic glasses (BMGs) and high entropy alloys (HEAs)
item.test_conditions: Complex stress fields, including stress gradients and notch geometries
key_findings: The initiation and propagation of shear bands in BMGs are significantly dependent on applied stress fields
Complex stress fields can improve the macroscopic plastic deformation behavior of BMGs
The deformation behavior of HEAs shares similar characteristics with BMGs, including serrated plastic flows
The introducing of complex stress fields can result in the evolution of microstructures in HEAs
item.mechanism: The authors propose that the initiation and propagation of shear bands are influenced by the applied stress fields, and that complex stress fields can be tailored to achieve controllable plastic deformation behavior
item.limitations: The understanding of the deformation behavior of BMGs under complex stress fields still faces challenges, and some unresolved issues remain
item.future_work: Further investigations on the deformation behavior of HEAs under complex stress fields, and the development of BMG devices/structures with enhanced performance and predictable properties
quotes: The change of applied stress fields can significantly affect many aspects of the plastic deformation in BMGs
Complex stress fields play a significant role for elucidating the mechanisms on the plastic deformation in BMGs
The introducing of complex stress fields can result in the evolution of microstructures, such as phase transition and mechanical twining

records.text: Paper card. Question: How do complex stress fields affect the deformation behavior of bulk metallic glasses (BMGs) and high entropy alloys (HEAs)?. System: Bulk metallic glasses (BMGs) and high entropy alloys (HEAs). Test conditions: Complex stress fields, including stress gradients and notch geometries. Findings: The initiation and propagation of shear bands in BMGs are significantly dependent on applied stress fields; Complex stress fields can improve the macroscopic plastic deformation behavior of BMGs; The deformation behavior of HEAs shares similar characteristics with BMGs, including serrated plastic flows; The introducing of complex stress fields can result in the evolution of microstructures in HEAs. Mechanism: The authors propose that the initiation and propagation of shear bands are influenced by the applied stress fields, and that complex stress fields can be tailored to achieve controllable plastic deformation behavior. Limitations: The understanding of the deformation behavior of BMGs under complex stress fields still faces challenges, and some unresolved issues remain. Future work: Further investigations on the deformation behavior of HEAs under complex stress fields, and the development of BMG devices/structures with enhanced performance and predictable properties.
